label: Heavy going
summary: The Gulf remained the centre of global anxiety. Saudi air defences shot down a Houthi ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh, tanker attacks near Hormuz left oil on UAE beaches, and Brent crude rose to about $117, a four-year high. The IEA warned that Europe is entering winter with its gas storage at record lows. Gunmen killed at least seven people at a church in Jordan, and Russia dropped cluster bombs on Ukraine. Kenya reported a second Ebola death. Flash floods closed schools in Queensland. There was some progress. WHO began an Ebola vaccine trial in DR Congo, South Korea offered the North talks on the border, European and Middle Eastern ministers pressed for US-Iran diplomacy, and a PTSD treatment trial reported 68% remission. The weighted formula gave 38; no editorial adjustment.
